artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the large dark bread in the bottom left appears slightly 'mushy' or overly smooth in patches, lacking the crisp, irregular crackling expected of real rustic bread crust. It resembles a generated texture map rather than physical dough.

The small twisted rolls in the center-right area seem to merge into each other at the base. The boundaries between individual rolls are indistinct and blurry, suggesting a fusion artifact common in AI generation where repetitive objects blend together.
The baguettes in the mid-ground appear to warp slightly. Their cylindrical shapes lose consistency, and some ends seem to taper unnaturally or blend into the background shelf.
